canonical_project: Key Point Dagestan data center (Endirey, Khasavyurt district)
owner: Key Point Group (OOO Key Point Dagestan)
notes: First-stone ceremony marked official construction start in Endirey village, Khasavyurt district; first stage planned to launch Q4 2026; project ~5 bln RUB with 500-2000 server racks; SPV OOO Key Point Dagestan registered in Makhachkala.
